scoring.note: Score computed point-in-time at each entry decision from data up to that hour only (no lookahead). Liquidity and cross-venue need data that does not exist historically, so they are dropped and the remaining weights renormalize (see scripts/score.py). Because the liquidity dimension is dropped, the liquidity gate (cap at 4.0 for zero-liquidity signals) never applies in backtest mode, and the scored backtest (BTC/ETH/HYPE only) does not validate the trap filter for illiquid coins. Each scored trade records entry_score_dims and entry_score_missing so a score can be traced to the dimensions behind it.
